svg.title: MESH offline construction, online question answering, and communication design
svg.desc: Offline construction and online question answering share the same summaries and knowledge pages in Generated Output storage. Return evidence is an execution responsibility. CONFIDENTIAL - CPU and CONFIDENTIAL - GPU (NVIDIA - H100) use KMS for secure key management and communicate with one another.
